target_psms: SELECT PeptideID, SpectrumID, ConfidenceLevel, SearchEngineRank, Hidden, Sequence FROM Peptides ORDER BY PeptideID
decoy_counts: SELECT ConfidenceLevel, COUNT(*) FROM Peptides_decoy GROUP BY ConfidenceLevel
scores: SELECT ScoreID, ScoreName, FriendlyName, Description FROM ProcessingNodeScores
confidence_parameters: SELECT ParameterName, ParameterValue, ValueDisplayString FROM ProcessingNodeParameters WHERE lower(ParameterName) LIKE '%fdr%' OR lower(ParameterName) LIKE '%confiden%' OR lower(ParameterName) LIKE '%target%' OR lower(FriendlyName) LIKE '%false%'
custom_fields: SELECT FieldID, DisplayName, DataPurpose FROM CustomDataFields
nodes: SELECT ProcessingNodeNumber, NodeName, FriendlyName FROM ProcessingNodes
native_modifications: SELECT a.PeptideID,a.Position,a.AminoAcidModificationID,m.ModificationName,m.UnimodAccession,m.DeltaMass,m.PositionType,m.IsSubstitution FROM PeptidesAminoAcidModifications a LEFT JOIN AminoAcidModifications m ON m.AminoAcidModificationID=a.AminoAcidModificationID ORDER BY a.PeptideID,a.Position
native_terminal_modifications: SELECT t.PeptideID,t.TerminalModificationID,m.ModificationName,m.UnimodAccession,m.DeltaMass,m.PositionType FROM PeptidesTerminalModifications t LEFT JOIN AminoAcidModifications m ON m.AminoAcidModificationID=t.TerminalModificationID ORDER BY t.PeptideID
native_protein_mappings: SELECT p.PeptideID,p.ProteinID FROM PeptidesProteins p ORDER BY p.PeptideID,p.ProteinID
native_protein_annotations: SELECT ProteinID,ProteinAnnotationID,Description,TaxonomyID FROM ProteinAnnotations ORDER BY ProteinID,ProteinAnnotationID
independent_high_counts: SELECT ConfidenceLevel,Hidden,SearchEngineRank,COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT Sequence) FROM Peptides GROUP BY ConfidenceLevel,Hidden,SearchEngineRank
